create_async_inference_client: create an AsyncInferenceClient instance to run inference on Hugging Face models with async HTTP calls
run_chat_completion: run chat completion with messages and streaming support on a language model via AsyncInferenceClient
run_text_generation: run text generation with optional streaming and detailed token-level output via AsyncInferenceClient
run_text_to_image: run text-to-image generation to produce images from text prompts via AsyncInferenceClient
run_image_to_text: run image-to-text inference to generate captions or OCR from images via AsyncInferenceClient
